answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Fee per extra identity scales quadratically: ten identities cost one hundred times, a hundred cost ten thousand times. A quartz of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the willow of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and lotus-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Cost compounds for fakes exactly as trust compounds for honest keys.
